changedJudgment: Score stays 9.0 because the source geometry, exports and actual displayed sizes are unchanged, and the fresh captures preserve the same static strengths and small-size limitation. The shorter copy keeps native text useful without asking tiny hands to carry meaning. The v2 contract improves future handoff precision by separating UI tokens from character paints and banning stacked legacy CSS gestures. deductions.finding: At the 238px header width in the 320px viewport, mittens/collar remain optically dense and dark antenna stems become faint. The face, wordmark and overall silhouette remain readable. Preserved rig paths do not establish that each wing or a fine contact gesture is visibly distinguishable at this scale.

If a future surface depends on hand contact, wing distinction or acting, give the unchanged full rig enough displayed area and verify it at its minimum actual size; do not redraw anatomy or assume these narrow previews demonstrate fine gestures.
